climate_pressure: Coastal flooding/erosion and climate-related pressure to consider relocation.
documented_impact: Relocation decisions can separate households from valued land, livelihoods and community arrangements.
fcv_mediator: Incomplete consensus, insecure tenure and pre-existing mistrust in government or policing can shape the process.
possible_consequence: The practice paper warns of possible cohesion loss or disputes if relocation proceeds without adequate consensus; this is not measured conflict incidence.
alternative_explanations: Housing policy, development-led relocation, service inequality, policing and generational preferences may drive disputes independently of climate.
uncertainty: Prospective source-stated mechanism with qualitative local examples; no causal estimate or current legal interpretation. Not independently reverified in the 27 October 2026 remediation; check the cited passage before relying on this claim.
resilience_factors: Trusted mediation and inclusive consensus-building are proposed safeguards; their effects are not independently evaluated here.
compact_statement: Climate-related relocation may interact with tenure, consent and trust to create disputes; Fiji evidence supports a conditional risk mechanism, not climate-caused violence.
